metrics.profile_summary: Performance Marketing specialist with 3+ years of experience in Ecommerce and Lead Generation. Expert in managing high-budget Meta and Google Ads campaigns with a focus on ROAS, CPA, and full-funnel optimization.

experience.description: Manages PKR 1.2 Cr+ monthly spend across Meta and Google Ads for top fashion brands, executing full-funnel strategies and optimizing conversion rates.
Developed digital campaigns for Ecommerce and Lead Generation, optimizing landing pages and analyzing competitor data to maximize performance.
Managed paid search, PPC, and social media campaigns focused on brand awareness and lead generation.
Executed performance marketing efforts to drive growth and reduce cost-per-purchase (CPP).

strengths: Strong technical expertise in paid acquisition (Meta/Google Ads)
Experience managing significant monthly ad budgets
weaknesses: Insufficient total experience (approx 3.5 years vs required 5-7)
No evidence of people management or agency leadership
Degree is in Software Engineering rather than Marketing/Business
Lacks proven experience in organic and content strategy
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a skilled Performance Marketer but lacks the seniority, people management experience, and educational background required for a comprehensive Marketing Manager role.
